Headquarters: United States | Remote

About Upstart

At Upstart, we’re united by a mission that matters: to radically reduce the cost and complexity of borrowing for all Americans. Every day, we bring creativity, experimentation, and advanced AI to reshape access to credit, helping millions move forward financially with clarity and confidence.

As the leading AI lending marketplace, we partner with banks and credit unions to expand access to affordable credit through technology that’s both radically intelligent and deeply human. Our platform runs over one million predictions per borrower using more than 3,000 signals, powering smarter, fairer decisions for millions of customers. But the numbers only hint at the impact. Every idea, every voice, and every contribution moves us closer to a world where credit never stands between people and their financial progress.

We’re proudly digital-first, giving most Upstarters the flexibility to do their best work from wherever they thrive, alongside teammates across 80+ cities in the US and Canada. Digital-first doesn’t mean distant. We’re intentional about in-person connection through team onsites, planning sessions, and moments that spark creativity and trust. And whether you choose to work primarily from home or collaborate in-person from one of our offices in Columbus, Austin, the Bay Area, or New York City, you’ll have the support to work in the way that works best for you.

If you’re energized by tackling meaningful problems, excited to innovate with purpose, and motivated by work that truly matters, we’d love to hear from you.

The Team: 

At Upstart, our Applied AI team's mission is threefold:

• 

Agent Platform: Build and support the platform that makes it straightforward for non technical users across Upstart to build, launch, and operate AI agents (voice/chat/text) reliably.

• 

Borrower and Applicant Assistant Orchestration: Build the orchestration layer behind a unified personal assistant that shares context across specialized agents, giving applicants and borrowers a cohesive, assistant-like experience.

• 

Borrower-Connected Internal Workflows: Improve internal operational workflows that directly connect to applicant and borrower experiences, making them faster, smarter, and more efficient.

As Principal Engineer, LLM you will serve as a technical pathfinder and force multiplier for this team and the product squads we partner with. Rather than owning internal developer-tooling infrastructure or training foundation models from scratch, your mandate is to compress the time between an ambiguous idea and a reliable, user-facing AI system, while raising the applied AI bar across every squad you touch.

This role operates on an explicit 80/20 charter:

• 

0-to-1 Product and Architecture Pathfinder (~80%): Rapidly prototype high-ambiguity bets across our agent platform, cross-agent context orchestration, borrower-facing assistant experiences, and internal workflows. Partner directly with Product and Design to validate non-deterministic UX, establish clean architectural patterns, and hand off battle-tested evaluation contracts for engineering squads to scale.

• 

AI-Native Engineering Catalyst (~20%): While dedicated internal teams own Upstart's broader AI developer tooling and software-factory initiatives, you will serve as a visible practitioner on the product side. You will lead by example with agentic coding workflows and tight verification harnesses, partner with our internal tooling teams as an early adopter ("customer zero"), and help product squads adopt higher-leverage ways of working.

Because AI systems are non-deterministic, user experience is part of the architecture. Whether you are designing cross-agent handoffs, borrower-facing assistant flows, or internal operational tools, you will navigate real-world trade-offs across latency, unit economics, reliability, and user trust, and push back constructively when a simpler deterministic approach is the right call.

How you’ll make an impact

• 

De-risk 0-to-1 bets across the stack: Rapidly prototype ambiguous initiatives spanning multi-agent context sharing, UX for non technical users, platform primitives for launching agents, and borrower-connected internal workflows.

• 

Deliver durable evaluation contracts, not throwaway handoffs: Treat prototype code as disposable proof of concept, and hand off to engineers what they actually need to build production services with confidence: golden datasets, automated evaluation harnesses, documented failure-mode maps, latency/cost benchmarks, and clean architectural blueprints.

• 

Partner cleanly from spike to production: Align early with receiving squad tech leads to surface system constraints, support joint go/no-go decisions with Engineering and Product leadership (including killing unviable bets early), and stay engaged through initial productionization to review early PRs and debug edge-case model behavior.

• 

Design non-deterministic UX and orchestration together: Treat latency spikes, context loss between agents, subtle hallucinations, and fallback paths as systems design problems, shaping experiences that earn and protect borrower and operator trust.

• 

Make pragmatic applied AI trade-offs: Default to the simplest reliable solution first (prompting, context engineering, deterministic guardrails), and make clear architectural calls on model routing, fine-tuning, or distillation when latency, unit economics, or reliability require it.

• 

Raise the applied AI bar across squads: Model disciplined agentic coding and verification practices in your daily workflow, feed practical requirements back to internal tooling teams, and elevate engineering judgment across teams through active collaboration.

Minimum Qualifications 

• 

Software engineering foundation and live AI shipping: 8+ years of software engineering experience, along with hands-on experience shipping non-deterministic, user-facing LLM or AI products to real users.

• 

Agentic and LLM systems architecture: Deep practical experience designing production LLM systems involving structured outputs, tool calling, context engineering, retrieval/memory patterns, and multi-step or multi-agent orchestration (including state management and context sharing across agents).

• 

Production systems, latency, and reliability engineering: Strong distributed-systems and backend fundamentals for non-deterministic pipelines: async orchestration, streaming UX, caching, timeouts and fallback paths, rate-limit handling, and end-to-end observability/tracing to diagnose failures.

• 

Evaluation and quality engineering: Proven experience building golden datasets, automated evaluation harnesses (deterministic checks, heuristics, and LLM-as-a-judge), regression gates, and systematic failure-mode analyses.

• 

Safety, guardrails, and applied AI pragmatism: Strong instinct to reach for the simplest reliable tool first (deterministic logic, prompting, context engineering, guardrails against hallucinations and prompt/data risks), paired with sound judgment on when latency, unit cost, or reliability justify routing, fine-tuning, or distillation over frontier APIs.

• 

Full-stack prototyping fluency: Comfortable moving fast across backend and frontend stacks (such as Python, TypeScript/React, and modern REST or streaming APIs) to put working end-to-end prototypes in front of users and stakeholders quickly.

• 

Low-ego pathfinder collaboration and UX empathy: Track record aligning early with partner squads, handing off ownership cleanly without ego, and partnering directly with Product, Design, and operations or business leaders to turn ambiguous goals into concrete latency budgets and resilient fallback experiences.

• 

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or equivalent practical experience.

Preferred Qualifications

• 

Startup or 0-to-1 incubation DNA: Experience operating in early-stage or low-boundary environments where …

Headquarters: Americas Remote

Hi, I'm Manu, Engineering Manager at Customer.io. We're looking for experienced backend engineers who want to build and own the infrastructure that powers one of the most data-intensive platforms in marketing automation — systems that process millions of events per second, orchestrate complex workflows at scale, and keep everything running reliably for thousands of customers worldwide.

You'll work on the Platform team, tackling hard distributed systems problems: designing for fault tolerance, scaling services under real production pressure, and building the foundational layers that every other team at Customer.io depends on. This isn't just maintenance work — you'll shape the architecture of systems that need to be both highly available and constantly evolving.

If you're someone who gets energized by the intersection of scale, reliability, and developer experience — and wants ownership over infrastructure that truly matters — we'd love to talk.

What you'll bring:

• Deep experience with distributed systems and large-scale backend architecture

• Strong instincts around reliability, observability, and fault tolerance

• Comfort reasoning about performance, capacity, and trade-offs at scale

• Experience with event-driven systems, message queues, or data pipelines is a plus

• A collaborative mindset — you raise the team around you

About Customer.io

Over 9,000 companies - from scrappy startups to global brands - use our platform to send billions of emails, push notifications, in-app messages, and SMS every day. Customer.io powers automated communication that people actually want to receive.

We help teams send smarter, more relevant messages using real-time behavioral data. Under the hood: Go, React, Ember and AI help us ship fast and scale with confidence.

What We Value

Ownership

You drive technical direction across systems and teams. You move with urgency, build with empathy, and think long-term. You’ve led large-scale infrastructure initiatives and know what it takes to get them over the line.

Engineers with customer focus

You think about how infrastructure unlocks customer value. You care about developer experience, system design, and how your work shapes the customer experience.

A healthy disregard for “the way things are done”

You bring rigor and creativity. Best practices matter, but never more than forward motion.

What You’ll Do

• Design and evolve distributed systems in Go to handle billions of daily events and messages and store and index petabytes of data

• Lead architectural decisions around performance, reliability, and real-time event processing

• Improve service-to-service communication through better APIs, messaging systems, and event-driven patterns

• Work across teams to uncover bottlenecks and system issues, and lead initiatives to resolve them for a smoother customer experience

• Tackle high-throughput challenges across data pipelines, queues, and scheduling infrastructure

• Able to debug production systems at scale using effective instrumentation, and resolve issues quickly and confidently

• Participate in an on-call rotation as required, supporting the reliability of the systems you build

• Share knowledge and raise the bar through sharing your progress publicly with short videos, thoughtful writing, and mentorship

• Leverage AI tools to prototype, move faster, and make better decisions

What we're looking for

• Significant experience (typically 10+ years) building scalable, distributed systems in Go (or similar statically typed languages)

• Deep experience with databases - relational (MySQL, Postgres) and non-relational (DynamoDB, BigTable) - and how to make them fast

• Comfort working in cloud-native environments (AWS, GCP)

• Familiarity with APIs, observability, and operating production systems

• A bias for action over perfection, and pride in owning technical decisions

Compensation & Benefits

We believe in transparency. Starting salary for this role is $150,000 - $200,000 USD (or equivalent in local currency) depending on experience and subject to market rate adjustment. In addition to base salary, this role includes an equity grant in the form of stock options, so you share in the success you help build.

We know our people are what make us great, and we’re committed to taking great care of them. Our inclusive benefits package supports your well-being and growth, including 100% coverage of medical, dental, vision, mental health, and supplemental insurance premiums for you and your family. We also offer 16 weeks paid parental leave, unlimited PTO, stipends for remote work and wellness, a professional development budget, and more.

See full benefits here →

Our Process

No gotchas, no trick questions - just a clear, human process designed to help both of us make an informed decision.

• Application - We review everyone with care. Tell us why you're interested.

• Recruiter Call (30 mins) - Let’s chat about what you’re looking for and how we work.

• Hiring Manager Interview (60 mins) - Talk with one of our hiring managers about your working style and a project you've owned end-to-end, plus a short AI-assisted coding exercise.

• System Design Interview (60 mins) - A collaborative system design conversation focused on scaling challenges.

• Coding Interview (60 mins) - Pair with one of our engineers for an agentic live coding interview.

All final candidates will be asked to complete a background check and employment verifications as part of our pre-employment process.

Customer.io recognizes the stifling impact of systemic injustice on diverse communities. We commit to using our influence to increase inclusion and equity within the tech industry. We strive to build an inclusive team culture, implement bias-free hiring practices, and develop community partnerships to expand our global impact.

Zoom is the only video conference platform that we use, virtual interviews will be conducted using the video capability (i.e., not via the chat), and offers will be extended in writing on official Customer.io letterhead. Please be vigilant in all of your job search activity, and if you have any questions please contact jobs@customer.io.

Join us!

We believe in empathy, transparency, responsibility, and, yes, a little awkwardness. If you’re excited by what you read and want to build software that makes communication better for everyone—apply now.

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/customer-io-senior-software-engineer-backend-platform

Headquarters: Remote

Cadence is the clinical AI company automating the treatment of chronic disease. Its Clinical Intelligence takes on the routine, high-volume work of chronic care – monitoring patients, surfacing risks, and coordinating action – so clinicians can focus on the decisions that require them. Grounded in partnerships with more than 20 leading health systems, deep EMR integrations, dedicated medical group, and experience serving a population of more than 100,000 patients, the system learns from real-world care delivery, improving as it scales. Cadence has been recognized by TIME as one of the Top 100 HealthTech Companies and by LinkedIn as a Top Startup (#4, 2025).
The Role

We’re hiring a Clinical Navigator (Licensed Practical Nurse) to deliver virtual chronic care support for Medicare patients enrolled in Cadence care programs.

Clinical Navigators deliver proactive, patient-centered outreach and follow-through. Depending on program needs, this role includes structured patient check-ins, coaching and goal-setting, care coordination to close gaps in care, and addressing barriers such as access to resources, transportation, or medication refills. Clinical Navigators document patient interactions in the Cadence platform and collaborate closely with the clinical team to escalate concerns and coordinate next steps, ensuring patients feel supported, informed, and engaged throughout their care journey.

Schedule

This is a full-time, remote position based in the United States. Standard working hours are Monday through Friday, from 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM or 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM in the Pacific time zone.

What You’ll Do

• Conduct outbound telephonic patient outreach and provide one-on-one coaching and support to patients managing chronic conditions, including but not limited to type 2 diabetes, hypertension, and cardiovascular disease.

• Help patients execute personalized care plans and achieve their goals by providing education and coaching focused on behavior modification, nutrition, physical activity, and self-management strategies using evidence-based techniques such as motivational interviewing and SMART goals.

• Conduct comprehensive assessments of patients' health status, lifestyle behaviors, nutritional habits, and readiness to change.

• Educate patients on disease management, medication adherence, symptom recognition, and prevention strategies, and execute care delivery tasks in accordance with Cadence clinical policies and established protocols, under appropriate clinical supervision.

• Monitor patients' progress, adherence to treatment plans, and health outcomes through regular check-ins and remote monitoring tools.

• Document patient interactions, outcomes, and follow-up plans in the Cadence platform; identify barriers to care (including social needs) and connect patients with resources or internal support pathways.

• Collaborate in real time with clinicians and patient support teams using tools such as our Cadence Platform, Google Workspace, and Slack, and contribute feedback to improve workflows in a fast-moving, change-oriented environment.

These responsibilities are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by personnel assigned to this job classification. They are not to be construed as an exhaustive list of job duties performed by personnel in this classification. Other job related duties may be assigned by management.

Who You Are

• A clinician who thrives at the intersection of rigorous care standards and a care delivery model that is still being built.

• Skilled in patient education, coaching, and care coordination - you meet patients where they are in life, considering their age, lifestyle, and diet.

• Disciplined in documentation and follow-through, with the attention to detail required for accurate clinical records in a remote environment.

• Reliable and consistent in schedule adherence, with the interpersonal communication skills to build trust with patients over the phone.

• Comfortable working independently in a remote, fast-paced environment with evolving workflows, and tech-savvy enough to navigate and troubleshoot multiple systems simultaneously while keeping patients engaged.

• Comfortable using AI-assisted clinical tools (such as Gemini or Open Evidence) to support patient interactions and surface relevant clinical context, while maintaining clinical judgment as the primary guide for every patient decision.

• Biased toward action - you bring clinical authority to every interaction, make the call when it counts, and take ownership of outcomes.

What You Need

• An active compact multi-state LPN/LVN license in the state where you currently reside is required.

• At least 5 years of clinical experience as a Licensed Practical Nurse is required.

• Remote work readiness (including stable high-speed WiFi) is required.

• An active CA state LVN license is required

• Fluency in Spanish is preferred.

• Experience providing patient education and support to individuals managing chronic conditions is preferred.

• Fluency with AI-assisted clinical tools (such as Gemini, Open Evidence, or comparable platforms) and the ability to speak credibly with providers and patients about where AI supports care delivery and where human judgment remains non-negotiable.

Compensation

The anticipated salary range for this role is $26 - $31 per hour, which is based on role scope, level, and location. In addition to base compensation, this role may be eligible for incentive compensation as part of the overall total rewards package. This position is remote and based in the United States. Actual compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, skills, internal equity, and applicable law.

Benefits & Perks

• Competitive pay & equity*

• Fully remote

• Comprehensive health coverage: Medical, dental & vision

• Paid time off

• 401k plan + matching

• Paid parental leave

• Home office stipend

*benefit offerings may vary depending on job profile, job level and worker type 

Cadence is committed to equal opportunity and fairness regardless of race, color, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, nation of origin, ancestry, age, physical or mental disability, country of citizenship, medical condition, marital or domestic partner status, family status, family care status, military or veteran status or any other basis protected by local, state or federal laws. 

A notice to Cadence applicants: Our Talent team only directs candidates to apply through our official careers page at https://www.cadence.care/our-team.  Cadence will never refer you to external websites, ask for payment or personal information, or conduct interviews via messaging apps. We receive all applications through our website and anyone suggesting otherwise is not with Cadence.

If you require a reasonable accommodation during the hiring process, please contact people@cadencerpm.com

Candidate Privacy Notice & SMS Terms

When you apply for a position with Cadence, we may collect and process personal information related to your application and candidacy, including your name, contact information, resume/CV, work history, education, qualifications, interview notes, job preferences, compensation expectations, availability, and any other information you choose to provide during the application process.

We use this information to evaluate your qualifications, communicate with you about your application, schedule interviews, provide updates on your candidacy, maintain recruiting records, and consider you for current or future opportunities.

e04b9bcd4b958b07.description:
Headquarters: Remote

About the Team

At Netlify, we’re a remote-first, globally distributed company with 120+ employees working across 13 countries around the world. Together, we’re building the platform for building and shipping web apps, with a mission to help anyone bring their ideas to the web.

As a Talent Partner, you’ll play a key role in bringing in the people who will shape Netlify’s next stage of growth. You’ll partner closely with hiring leaders to help them make thoughtful, high-quality hiring decisions and will be deeply embedded in understanding this evolving job market and what makes not only great talent, but folks who align with Netlify’s mission.  With our team, you’ll recruit across a wide variety of teams and talent markets, owning the full recruiting lifecycle and partnering closely with leaders across Sales, Marketing, Engineering, Product, Finance and other functions. Rather than specializing in one area, you’ll build context quickly, learn what great talent looks like across different parts of the business, and help us find and hire exceptional people. 

We’ve already built a number of our own tools and workflows on Netlify to make our day-to-day work better, and we’re continuing to experiment with how AI can create even more leverage. With our team, you’ll be using the same platform you’re helping grow the team behind by shipping tools that improve your own work, experimenting with new ways of working, and contributing to how we continue to evolve how we hire.

What You'll Do

• Own full-cycle recruiting across a broad mix of functions -  GTM, G&A, and R&D - from intake through accepted offer, without needing a sourcer, coordinator, or ops partner to be effective

• Run search kickoffs, define and calibrate candidate profiles in partnership with hiring managers, and establish your own search strategy rather than waiting for one to be handed to you

• Independently develop proactive sourcing approaches for each search and build pipelines of passive talent while continuing to cultivate talent for difficult-to-fill roles and future hiring needs

• Conduct recruiter screens and develop a clear, evidenced point of view on candidates - sending hiring managers slates with real recommendations

• Own weekly search meetings with hiring managers: bring funnel data, market feedback, and a perspective on what's working and what isn't; diagnose problems and propose changes rather than just reporting that pipeline is light

• Act as a trusted talent advisor to hiring managers as you partner with them on their searches,  bringing market insight, recruiting expertise, and thoughtful pushback when it will lead to a stronger hiring decision

• Partner across the People Team on talent strategy, workforce and organizational planning with HR Business Partners, and with People Operations on scalable solutions and processes.

• Manage offers and candidate closing end-to-end, while delivering a responsive, thoughtful, and high-touch candidate experience throughout every stage of the process -  including for candidates we ultimately don't hire

• Use recruiting metrics such as funnel conversion, time to fill, time to hire, sourcing performance, and candidate feedback to identify patterns, inform decisions, and continuously improve how we hire

• Design and build AI-assisted and vibe-coded recruiting workflows, evaluate them critically, and identify new opportunities to create leverage - without waiting to be assigned an automation project

What You'll Bring

• Enough full-cycle recruiting reps to operate independently from day one - you've had several years of experience personally run intake, sourced, screened, managed HM relationships, and closed candidates across multiple simultaneous searches

• A track record of encountering unfamiliar roles or functions and figuring out how to recruit them effectively, rather than defaulting to a narrow specialty

• A history of sourcing and engaging passive candidates, ideally at companies where the logo wasn't doing most of the recruiting for you - you've had to create interest, not just harvest it

• Demonstrated ability to partner with hiring managers by running search meetings, interpret and pushing back on feedback, recognizing when calibration is off, and owning the relationship

• Experience using funnel data to change your behavior - when four candidates get rejected, your instinct is to investigate why, not to source a fifth

• You can execute quickly across a high volume of searches while maintaining a high bar for quality, balancing speed with the judgment needed to find the right talent for highly specialized roles.

• Experience working with imperfect infrastructure - you've operated without a dedicated sourcer, coordinator, or mature ops team and made it work

• A history of noticing broken or inefficient workflows and doing something about them, whether through AI tools, automation, process changes, or creative problem-solving - you've improved something without being told to

• Strong organization and communication skills, with the ability to keep multiple searches, stakeholders, candidates, and decisions moving in a distributed environment without sacrificing the details or the human experience

• Proficiency with an ATS and the broader recruiting toolset (we use Greenhouse), and comfort experimenting with AI-powered tools to meaningfully improve recruiting quality or throughput

• We don't require educational qualifications for the role - we're interested in the experience, judgment, and skills you've developed through your work.

This Role is a Great Fit If

• You care deeply about the people behind every application and recognize that looking for a new role is a meaningful decision in someone’s life. You lead with empathy, communicate openly, and follow through on what you say you’ll do. Whether someone joins Netlify or not, you want them to feel that their time was respected, they were treated with care, and they had a thoughtful experience with us.

• You're energized by functional variety. An unfamiliar finance role or a senior engineering search doesn't become "that's not my specialty." You get curious, ask good questions, and figure it out

• You work well in an environment that resets every few months. Priorities shift, reqs change, and that doesn't throw you -  you reorient and keep moving

The Information Security organization advances the overall state of security at Rubrik through critical initiatives and coordination of large security projects. Information Security builds technologies, tools, and processes to better enable teams at Rubrik to develop secure software and protect data and systems with appropriate security controls. Information Security also develops systems to monitor and respond to attacks against our assets, provides awareness education to teams on security best practices for data protection, and ensures data governance and data sharing relationships with third parties in order to securely protect Rubrik information.

 

About the role:

Rubrik is seeking a Senior Information Security Analyst to support and oversee activities within the Customer Trust function at our Bangalore, India office. As a member of the Customer Trust team, you will be a highly motivated professional responsible for executing key service areas and driving their continuous improvement and maturity. The successful candidate will build and maintain strong cross-functional relationships across the organization while demonstrating exceptional interpersonal skills and the ability to confidently lead customer-facing discussions and engagements. This role requires strong leadership, communication, collaboration, and decision-making skills, along with the ability to work effectively across multiple stakeholders and priorities.

What you’ll do:

We are looking for a highly motivated individual that wants to be a part of a front-line customer facing function of security within Rubrik that helps sales close revenue opportunities by sharing Rubrik’s security posture with customers. Key responsibilities include sharing Rubrik's security posture with customers by interacting with key security stakeholders in the customers organization, responding to customer RFPs, redlining security terms in customer contracts, facilitating customer audits and other customer requests that are related to Rubrik's enterprise or product security and compliance capabilities. In this role, you will:

  • Respond to security and compliance portions of customer RFPs in an accurate and timely fashion (i.e., within agreed upon internal SLAs), leveraging AI generated responses and validating responses..
  • Lead and collaborate with other Information Security, Product security and Engineering SMEs, as needed to respond to customers and drive security posture outcomes.
  • Build narratives and perform security reviews of new products to ensure there are accurate responses for RFPs.
  • Support security and compliance related customer audits, as requested.
  • Be well-versed in Rubrik's products, particularly as they pertain to security and compliance features and secure SDLC practices.
  • Work with Sales Operations, Field Operations, Sales, Sales Engineering, Marketing, and Engineering teams to intake requests and drive improvements to the customer trust process.
  • Execute operational activities related to the maturity and measurement of the customer trust process to provide high quality services that enable sales at Rubrik.
  • Drive the maturity of the customer facing collateral that disseminates security and compliance related announcements and thought leadership to new customers and prospects.
  • Support the finalisation of security and compliance language in customer contracts.
  • Be well versed with industry leading frameworks such as DORA, ISO 27001, SOC 2, PCI,DSS, HIPAA and HITRUST

  • 5+ years of related work experience in Customer Trust & Security Assurance in the tech industry, preferably in the cyber resilience space.

  • Have driven several security and/or operational Information security processes within a company.
  • Experience reviewing and negotiating contracts as it relates to security and compliance obligations
  • Ability to meet demanding timelines and SLAs, manage changing priorities and execute tasks with minimal supervision.
  • Knowledge of common security risks, vulnerabilities, and threats and can translate these issues through triage / risk treatment conversations.
  • Understanding of information security frameworks and compliance requirements, such as DORA, ISO 27001/2 (including ISO 27017 & 18), FedRAMP, SOC 2 Trust Services Criteria, CIS Top 20, PCI DSS, HIPAA, and NIST CSF / 800-53.
  • Detail-oriented and able to understand the bigger picture by using your technical expertise and problem solving abilities to prioritize and manage blocking issues.
  • Able to discuss issues at technical and business levels with audiences of various backgrounds.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Security, Computer Science, Management Information Systems or related field preferred.

  • Partner with hiring teams on structured, equitable technical interviews with clear competencies and actionable feedback; challenge assumptions and escalate risks or blockers early.
  • Use talent-market research, compensation benchmarks, funnel metrics, and candidate feedback to shape search strategy and address hiring issues.
  • Assess technical candidates on depth of experience, scope and impact of past work, problem-solving, and open source or community contributions, and how well their skills fit GitLab's teams and technology.
  • Build research-based, diversity-focused sourcing plans that balance applicants, passive talent, referrals, internal talent, and targeted outreach across technical communities and specialized talent pools.
  • Deliver a thoughtful candidate experience through disciplined pipeline management, proactive communication, timely feedback, and offer negotiations that clearly explain compensation, equity, and benefits.
  • Improve recruiting practices by sharing learnings and reusable resources, using artificial intelligence (AI) responsibly, and representing GitLab's mission, values, and culture.

What you'll bring

  • Intermediate-level recruiting experience, with a track record of owning full-cycle searches independently.
  • Technical recruiting experience, or a strong interest in learning engineering and product disciplines, tech stacks, team structures, and how software is built and shipped.
  • Developing advisor skills: building stakeholder trust, influencing without authority, and managing hiring team expectations.
  • Experience building proactive, diversity-focused sourcing strategies and balanced pipelines for hard-to-fill or specialized roles.
  • A data-informed approach that turns funnel insights into practical actions.
  • Strong organization across multiple requisitions and clear written and verbal communication across time zones, with attention to detail and candidate care.
  • Experience with an applicant tracking system and recruiting tools such as Greenhouse, LinkedIn Recruiter, LinkedIn Insights, SeekOut, or comparable platforms; ability to evaluate AI-generated work, protect confidential information, and share responsible workflows with team members.
  • Experience recruiting for DevSecOps, developer tools, or open source software is helpful, not required.

About the team

We work in a globally distributed, remote-first Talent Acquisition team where clear communication and reliable follow-through matter. Our team members share learnings and create reusable resources to improve the quality and consistency of hiring across Research & Development.

The base salary range for this role’s listed level is currently for residents of the United States only. This range is intended to reflect the role's base salary rate in locations throughout the US. Grade level and salary ranges are determined through interviews and a review of education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities of the applicant, equity with other team members, alignment with market data, and geographic location. The base salary range does not include any bonuses, equity, or benefits. See more information on our benefits and equity. Sales roles are also eligible for incentive pay targeted at up to 100% of the offered base salary.

United States Salary Range
$86,400—$176,400 USD

How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees

  • Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being
  • Flexible Paid Time Off 
  • Team Member Resource Groups
  • Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan
  • Growth and Development Fund

About ElevenLabs
ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.
We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:
• 
ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.
• 
ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.
• 
ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.
Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work
• 
High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.
• 
Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.
• 
AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.
• 
Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.
• 
Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer
• 
Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.
• 
Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.
• 
Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.
• 
Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.
• 
Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.
• 
Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.
About the Role
As Mid-Market Lead, you will be the strategic driver behind scaling and optimizing our Mid-Market AE organization in the Eastern US. You’ll own revenue outcomes and team performance across our Mid-Market segment, with a strong focus on building repeatable, high-velocity sales motions. This role blends hands-on leadership with strategic execution in a fast-growing environment.
In this role, you will:
• 
Define and execute the go-to-market strategy for U.S. Mid-Market accounts, including quotas, segmentation, and territory design.
• 
Lead, coach, and scale a team of Mid-Market AEs, owning recruiting, onboarding, enablement, and performance management.
• 
Own pipeline health and forecasting, driving consistency and improving conversion rates across each stage of the funnel.
• 
Develop and refine sales playbooks, motions, objection frameworks, and deal models tailored to Mid-Market buyers and voice AI / conversational use cases.
• 
Partner cross-functionally with Marketing, Product, Growth, and Customer Success to align positioning, messaging, and expansion opportunities.
• 
Establish feedback loops by synthesizing insights from prospects and customers to help inform GTM strategy and product roadmap decisions.
Requirements
• 
7+ years of SaaS or technology sales experience, with meaningful experience leading or scaling Mid-Market AE teams.
• 
Demonstrated success surpassing revenue targets in a Mid-Market or velocity-oriented sales environment.
• 
Strong command of sales metrics, funnel optimization, forecasting, and process rigor.
• 
Experience selling technical, AI, or API-driven solutions to Director- and VP-level stakeholders.
• 
Excellent communication skills and ability to influence across teams and seniority levels.
• 
Comfortable operating in fast-paced, ambiguous, high-growth environments with high ownership.

Location
This role is remote-first, however the ability to operate in EST timezones is required. There is a preference for candidates to be based in New York, with the option to work out of our office.

e0e698bcff96a880.description: Hey there! We are seeking a curious developer to join our **Engineering team** at Procedure. We're a product development company established in early 2017. Of the early risers and the burners of the midnight oil. We appreciate diversity and truly like having differing perspectives in the room. We pride ourselves on being early adopters of the latest tools, libraries and frameworks while delivering business value all the time. People who work with us fall in love with their craft. We have changed the definition of "work" for them. **Here are some of our beliefs about work** * **Work is only 1 part of your life** and not your entire life. We treat it as such. * **Weekends are sacred** and not to be messed around with. You won't be asked to work on one. * **Commuting is a waste of time**. Working from home saves you additional time. Go crazy with it. * **Side gigs are welcome**. We believe there are multiple avenues to learn and grow. Why restrict it to only work? * **We pride ourselves on being early adopters of the latest tools**, libraries and frameworks while always delivering business value. People who work with us fall in love with their craft. We have changed the definition of "work" for them. **Apart from work, we continually invest in growing you as a professional and a human.** * **Extensive Boot Camp** - learn, regardless of your experience, about Data Structure and Algorithms, LLD, HLD, DevOps, frontend, backend and/or test engineering. * **Book club** - broaden your horizons by picking up a book every month and have fun doing so * **P1, The Half Yearly Tech Conference** - here's where we explore futuristic themes to keep you informed about what's happening in the tech space outside our office. * **Internal Projects** - where your craft, experiment and learning precede deadlines. Also, try out new technologies and domains. **Growth requires mentorship** We believe choosing a mentor is more important than choosing a company. My co-founder, Braj, and I have over a decade of experience in our respective fields. I will be mentoring you to become a better engineer and a coder. Braj will help you with domain expertise, product thinking and problem-solving. When you chat with us, ask us how it has helped our ex-employees in their careers. **What's it like here** We love debating over languages and frameworks and want someone who can bring their opinions to these discussions. We love reading/sharing articles, podcasts, tech essays. If you love tea or coffee, Marvel or DC, Peterson or Zizek, or even something eclectic, you will feel right at home. Continuous improvement is at the heart of everything we do at work & outside. **This sounds good. But what exactly will you work on?** Since we are a service company, you will have the advantage of working on a wide gamut of problems, technology & real world-wise. You will be involved in all stages of a product lifecycle. You'll never have to wonder why you are working on something because you'll always know it. **What are you currently working on?** We carefully select our clients. This is to ensure we are always indexed well on challenging work. They include indie entrepreneurs, Series B/C funded startups and big corporates. Some of the sectors we are working on * Healthtech * Edtech * Insurtech * Sportstech * Fintech And much more! ***Trust us - there's never a dull day at work.*** **Here’s what we expect from you** 1. **You love coding and think of it as a craft**. We wouldn't have it otherwise. 2. You should have good experience in **AI-native full-stack**. 3. **Frontend skills**: You have a good knowledge of the basics of **Javascript/Typescript (frontend)** and You have experience in creating modularised code in React. You know when to use HOCs, Hooks, Context and their trade-offs. You can create a slick webpage using HTML and CSS alone. 4. **Backend skills**: You have a solid grasp of the basics of **Python or JavaScript/TypeScript.** You’ve built and maintained REST APIs using frameworks like **Django/Django Rest Framework (Python) or Express/Fastify (Node.js)**. You understand persistence and can work your way around Django ORM or any SQL/NoSQL store confidently. 5. You can set up your stack on a cloud provider of your choice. 6. You have a good understanding of SOLID principles — enough to know when these are useless. 7. You aren't complacent about your skillset and have a hunger to learn more. 8. You like to share your learnings with others. If you have made it this far, I think we should have a chat. Apply now! - *P.S. We are expecting candidates who can join by this month; if you are an immediate joiner, apply here directly - https://procedure.keka.com/careers/jobdetails/126014 - and reach out to https://www.linkedin.com/in/adithya-k-people/ for prioritising your profile.*

e0658f8c346b104a.description: We are seeking a motivated and enthusiastic Machine Learning Engineer to join our team in Maharashtra. If you are a recent graduate looking to kickstart your career in machine learning and artificial intelligence, we encourage you to apply and be a part of our innovative team.
